paite: Chidam ludam a na om ua, na hong tam semsem ua, nou hon pe dia na pi-le-pute uh kiang a TOUPA'N akichiamna gam na va luahtheihna ding un ka hon thupiak tengteng zui ding in pilvang un.
heading: Luah Ding Gam Hoih

paite: Athupiakte na zui ding uhia, zui lou ding, na lungsim uh theihna dia enchian ding leh hon hihgim dia gamdai a kum sawmli sung nou ahon pina lampi tengteng theigige un.

Tanghou kia in mihing ahing kei. TOUPA kam a thu chih pawt in ahing zaw, chih nou ahon theihsak theihna ding in hon hihgim a, na kial uh aphal a, na theih ngei louh uh, na pi-le-pute un leng atheih ngei louh uh manna in ahon vak hi.
Hiai kum sawmli sung in na puansilhte uh na silhtul kei ua, na khete uh leng abawk kei hi.
Mi'n ata asawi bang in TOUPA na Pathian un nou hon sawi ahi, chih na lungsim un thei un.
Alampi zui dia amah laudan siam ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zui ding uh ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian un phaizangte leh mualte a pan hong pawtkhia luitui, tuikhuk leh tui thukpi omna gam;
buh, barli buh, grep, theipi leh theibuhfaite omna gam; thau nei olive leh khuaizu omna gam;
kitatlak lou a tanghou na nekna ding gam uh, bangmah na taksaplouhna ding uh, asuangte bang sik, atangte dal laihkhiak theihna gam hoih mahmah ah nou hon pilut ding ahi ngal a.
Na neih ua, na tai mahmah chiang un, gam hoih mahmah ahon piak ziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh na phat ding uh ahi.
Athupiakte, adan thusehte leh adante, tuni a ka hon piak zui lou in TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh kha mahmah ding uh, pilvang un.
heading: TOUPA Mangngilh Lou Dia Vauhilhna

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na nek ua, na tai ua, inn hoih taktak na lam ua, na luah chiang un;
na ganhon uh, na belamhon uh ahong tam a, na dangka uh, na dangka-eng uh ahong tam a, na thil neih tengteng uh ahong tam hun chiang in na lungtang uh akisathei kha dia,
Aigupta gam a saltanna inn a pan noute hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh mai kha ding uh,
Ama'n gamdai zatak leh lauhuaitak, gul gukhahte leh aikamte omna, tui omlouhna, gamkeu ah hon pi paisuak a;

suangpi a pan meisah suang tui ahon pawtkhesak a, na pi-le-pute uh theih ngei louh, manna in nou ahon vak a, tunung chiang khualna a na hoihtheihna ding un nou hon hihgim a, ahon chet theihna ding in.
"Hiai i sum-le-paite eimah hatna leh i khut hatna in asepkhiak ahi," na lungtang un na chi kha ding uh, pilvang un.
Tua na kip bang ua na pi-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a thu akhun ahihkipna ding in TOUPA na Pathian uh theigige un, sum-le-pai muhkhiak theihna hon pepa lah amah ahi ngal a.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh na mangngilh ua, pathian dangte na zuih ua, a-nna uh na sep ua, na biak uleh, na mangthang ngeingei ding uh, chih tuni in ka hon theisak ahi.
Na ma ua namdangte ahihmanthat bang in noute leng na mangthang ding uh, TOUPA na Pathian aw ngaikhe ut lou na hih ding ziak un.
